title: Southern-Style Cauliflower Nuggets
subtitle: with Fries, Corn Cobs and Beans
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep fries: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into 1cm-thick fries and put on a lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat.

Crumb cauliflower nuggets: Cut the cauliflower into 6 large florets. Combine the breadcrumbs and barbecue seasoning in a shallow bowl. Put the cornflour and 2 tbs plant-based milk (see Make it yours) in a large bowl and stir to form a smooth, thick batter. Dip the cauliflower florets in the batter, shake off the excess, then coat in the breadcrumb mixture.

Roast nuggets and fries: Put the cauliflower nuggets on the remaining lined tray and spray generously with olive oil. Roast the cauliflower nuggets on the upper oven shelf and the fries on the lower shelf for 30-35 mins until golden and tender.

Cook corn and beans: Meanwhile, bring a large saucepan of water to the boil for the beans and corn. Discard the husk and silks from the corn, then cut the cob into 2cm-thick rounds. Trim the beans. Cook the corn in the pan of boiling water for 3 mins. Add the beans and cook for a further 2-3 mins until the corn and beans are tender. Drain, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the cauliflower nuggets, fries and corn and beans among plates. Serve with the vegan mayonnaise and barbecue sauce, if using. Enjoy!
Make it yours: If you don't follow a vegan diet, just use whatever milk and mayonnaise you have on hand.
